headline: Name the 8 cranial bones of the skull
body:
O = Occipital
P = Parietal (2)
F = Frontal
T = Temporal (2)
E = Ethmoid
S = Sphenoid
source: Source: Cleveland Clinic, Skull: Anatomy & Function

headline: Why your two lungs aren't twins
stat_note: lobes in the right lung vs the left lung
body: Right: superior, middle and inferior lobes. Left: superior and inferior, with a cardiac notch that makes room for your heart.

headline: How much blood is in your body?
body: Blood makes up about 8% of your body weight. Plasma is about 55% of it, red blood cells about 44%.
